title: Words to read and colour: Finding An-Nasr words in the mushaf
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: An-Nasr, Al-Kafirun and reading joined words
source: Written for quran/y1 lesson 32 (Pupil PDF worksheet: words to read and colour)
intro: Lesson 32. Read each word slowly to a grown-up, then colour the part we learned today (Finding An-Nasr words in the mushaf). Then trace and copy.

panels.title: Finding An-Nasr
points: Near the end of the mushaf
Look for the name at the top

arabic.text: إِذَا جَآءَ نَصْرُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْفَتْحُ (١) وَرَأَيْتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًۭا (٢) فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابًۢا (٣)

questions.q: Point to «ٱلنَّاسَ» in 110:2 and read it.
Word hunt: find and read the four words on the pupil PDF in your mushaf. The teacher listens to today's group read 110:1.
Where do we keep the mushaf?
Think again: The mushaf is Allah's Book. How should we hold it and look after it?
questions.a: With clean hands, gently, on a clean place, never on the floor.
